With ﬁ rst Muslim invasion of India in 7th century and later in with Turko-Mongol invasion in 14th century, policy and culture of India changed. A complex amalgamation of Perso-Arabic, Turko-Mongol-Indian elements came fore front to rule. 45. In what context does 'Panahi' and 'Upanah' mention in the medieval Indian History? (a) Cloth (b) Jewellery (c) Accommodation (d) Shoes M.P.P.C.S. (Pre.) 2020 Ans (d) Wooden Sandals were used in India since ancient times. Of late, the use of leather or other material to make footwear developed. During medieval time too shoes/sandals/leather slippers were called charanpaduka, panahi or upanah. Hence correct option is (d) shoes. Sikh Sect *The founder of Sikhism and the ﬁ rst Guru of Sikhs was Guru Nanak. There are total of 10 gurus in Sikhism. They are Guru Nanak, Guru Angad, Amar Das, Ramdas, Arjun Dev, Hargovind, Harrai, Harkishan, Tegh Bahadur and Guru Govind Singh. *Guru Angad is considered as the progenitor of ‘Gurumukhi script’. *Akbar donated land of 500 Bighas which had a natural pond also to the fourth Sikh Guru Ramdas. The city of Amritsar was established on the land granted by Akbar to Guru Ramdas and his wife, Bibi Bhani. *Fifth Sikh Guru Arjun Dev compiled the holy book of Sikhism ‘Adi Granth’ in 1604 AD. *Guru Amardas divided the religious empire into 22 parts called Manjis. Each Manjis was under the authority of a Sikh. B–314 General Studies Indian History *Guru Arjun Dev constructed ‘Harmandir’ in the middle of the Amritsar pond. He established two cities called Tarantaran and Kartarpur and started a Masand custom, according to which the Sikhs had to pay one-tenth of their income to Guru. *Adi Granth or Guru Granth Sahib was compiled by Arjun Dev, the fifth Sikh guru (1581AD- 1606AD). It contains preachings of six Sikh Gurus, many Hindu devotees, Kabir, Baba Farid, Namdev and Raidas. The starting lines of Adi Granth was written by Bengali Vaishnav poet Jaydev and the last lines were written by Guru Teg Bahadur. Guru Arjun Dev was sentenced to death by Jahangir and Guru Teg Bahadur was sentenced to death by Aurangzeb. *The tenth and the last Guru of Sikhs, Guru Govind Singh, converted Sikhs into a military sect ‘Khalsa Panth’. It was established on 13th April, 1699 in ‘Anandpur Sahib’ on the day of Baisakhi. He called the whole Sikh community as ‘Khalsa’. He ordered Sikhs that each Sikh should have the surname of Singh and have hold Kesh, Kangha, Kachha, Kripan and Kada. *The tenth and the last Sikh Guru Gobind Singh, was assassinated in Nanded, Maharashtra by an Afghan noble. Nanded Gurudwara is situated at his mausoleum there. *The real name of Banda Bahadur was Laxman Dev or Lakshan Dev. This name was given to him by Sikh Guru Govind Singh. 1. Who had Guru Nanak appointed his successor? (a) Guru Ramdas (b) Guru Amardas (c) Guru Har Rai (d) Guru Angad M.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2015 Ans. (d) Guru Nanak died on September 22, 1539 at the age of 70. He appointed Bhai Lehna as his successor who was later known as Guru Angad. 2. Which of the following was declared as his successor by Guru Nanak? (a) Bala (b) Lehna (c) Mardana (d) Sri Chand U.P.R.O./A.R.O. (Pre.) 2021 Ans (b) See the explanation of above question. 3. The city of Amritsar in Punjab was established by: (a) Guru Nanak (b) Guru Gobind Singh (c) Guru Tegh Bahadur (d) Guru Ramdas U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 1996 Ans. (d) Akbar donated the land of 500 bighas to fourth Sikh Guru Ramdas which had a natural pond. Amritsar was established on the land which was granted by Akbar to Guru Ramdas and his wife, Bibi Bhani. Firstly, the city was named as Ramdaspur. Later, it came to be known as ‘Amritsar’ on the name of the natural pond present there. 4. To which Sikh Guru, Akbar donated 500 Bighas of land? (a) Arjun Dev (b) Ramdas (c) Har Rai (d) Tegh Bahadur Uttrakhand U.D.A./L.D.A. (Mains) 2007 Ans. (b) See the explanation of above question. 5. Which of the following pairs is correctly matched? (a) Guru Amar Das - Miri and Piri (b) Guru Arjun Dev - Adi Granth (c) Guru Ramdas - Dal Khalsa (d) Guru Gobind Singh - Manji I.A.S. (Pre) 1996 Ans. (b) Fifth Sikh Guru Arjun Dev compiled the holy book of Sikhism "Adi Granth" in 1604. He was executed by Jahangir for aiding to Prince Khusrau. Guru Amardas divided the religious empire into 22 branches called Manjis and appointed a local Sikh preacher at each place. Dal Khalsa was established by Kapur Singh. 6. Which Sikh Guru helped rebel prince Khusrau with shelter and wealth : (a) Guru Hargobind Singh (b) Guru Gobind Singh (c) Guru Arjun Dev (d) Guru Tegh Bahadur U.P. U.D.A./L.D.A. (Pre) 2001 Ans. (c) Prince Khusrau revolted in 1606. He escaped to Punjab where he got the blessing and some ﬁ nancial help from Guru Arjun Dev. Jahangir got displeased with Guru Arjun Dev. He ﬁ ned Guru Arjun Dev with 2.5 Lakh rupees. After the rejection, Guru Arjun Dev was imprisoned and awarded death by torture and suﬀ ered the ﬁ rst great martyrdom. He was the 5th Guru of Sikhs. He constructed Harmandir Sahib in the lake of Amritsar. He established two cities named Taran Taran and Kartarpur. He practised the custom of ‘’Mand’’ in which 10th part of the income was compulsory given to Guru by every Sikh. Indian History General Studies B–315 7. Who of the following compiled “Adi Granth or Guru Granth Saheb”? (a) Guru Nanak Dev (b) Guru Tegh Bahadur (c) Guru Gobind Singh (d) Guru Arjun Dev Uttarakhand P.C.S. (Pre) 2005 Uttarakhand P.C.S. (Pre) 2002 Uttarakhand P.C.S. (Pre) 2004 Ans. (d) Adi Granth or Guru Granth Sahib was compiled by Arjun Dev, 5th Sikh Guru (1581-1606). It contains preachings of six Sikh Gurus, many Hindu devotees, Kabir, Baba Farid, Namdev and Raidas. The ﬁ rst line of Adi Granth was written by Bengali Vaishnav poet Jaydev and the last line was written by Guru Tegh Bahadur. 8. Which of the following Sikh Gurus were penalized with death by the Rulers of the time : 1. Guru Angad 2. Guru Arjun Dev 3. Guru Har Gobind 4. Guru Tegh Bahadur Select the correct answer from the code given below: Code : (a) 2 and 4 (b) 2 and 3 (c) 1 and 3 (d) 1 and 2 U.P.U.D.A./L.D.A. (Pre) 2002 Ans. (a) Guru Arjun Dev and Guru Tegh Bahadur were awarded death sentence by their contemporary rulers, Jahangir and Aurangzeb respectively. Guru Arjun Dev (1581-1606)- He was the 5th Sikh Guru. After the revolt against Jahangir, his rebellious son Prince Khusrau ﬂ ed from Agra to Afghanistan. During his escape Khusrau met Guru Arjun Dev at Taran Taran city. Guru gave him support and shelter due to which Jahangir got angry with Guru Arjun Dev. Jahangir accused him of conspiracy and sentenced him to death sentence in 1606. Guru Arjun Dev established Taran Taran and Kartarpur towns. His major work was a compilation of Guru Granth Sahib. He started to run ‘’Mand’’ system in which 10th part of the income was donated to Guru by every Sikh. Guru Tegh Bahadur (1664-1675): Revered as the ninth Nanak, he was the ninth of ten Gurus of the Sikh religion. According to the records written by his son Guru Gobind Singh, the Guru had resisted persecution, adopted and promised to protect Kashmiri Hindus. The Guru was summoned to Delhi by Aurangzeb on the protest but when he arrived, he was oﬀ ered “to abandon his faith and convert to Islam.” Guru Tegh Bahadur refused, he and his associates were arrested. He was executed on November 11, 1675 before the public in Chandni Chowk, Delhi. 9. Aurangzeb is responsible for which Sikh prophet’s death? (a) Guru Gobind Singh (b) Guru Tegh Bahadur (c) Guru Ramdas (d) Guru Angad Chhattisgarh P.C.S. (J) (Pre) 2005 Chhattisgarh P.C.S. (J) (Pre) 2004 Ans. (b) See the explanation of above question. 10. At which of the following places is a famous Sikh Gurudwara located ? (a) Roop Kund (b) Hem Kund (c) Tara Kund (d) Brahm Kund Uttrakhand U.D.A./L.D.A. (Mains) 2006 Ans. (b) The famous Sikh gurudwara is located in Hem Kund (Chamoli, Uttarakhand). 11. Which Sikh Guru was born in Patna? (a) Nanak (b) Tegh Bahadur (c) Hargobind (d) Gobind Singh 56th to 59th B.P.S.C (Pre) 2015 Ans. (d) Guru Gobind Singh was the tenth and the last Sikh Guru. He was born in 1666 in Patna, in the east India province of Bihar. He introduced ‘Khalsa Panth’ and consolidated the Sikh community as a warrior. 12. Nanded is considered sacred by Sikhs due to whose Mausoleum ? (a) Guru Amardas (b) Guru Angad (c) Guru Arjun Dev (d) Guru Gobind Singh U.P. Lower Sub. (Pre) 2002 Ans. (d) The 10th Sikh Guru and last Guru, Guru Gobind Singh was assassinated in Nanded (Maharastra) by an Afghani noble. Nanded Gurudwara is situated at his mausoleum there. 13. Guru Gobind Singh’s greatness lies in the fact that : (a) He formed the military order of Sikhs (b) He was the founder of Sikh state B–316 General Studies Indian History (c) He made Sikhs peaceful (d) He defeated Aurangzeb R.A.S./R.T.S. (Pre) 1993 Ans. (a) The 10th Guru and last prophet of Sikh, Guru Gobind Singh converted Sikhs into a military sect ‘’Khalsa Panth’’. He called the whole Sikh community as ‘’Khalsa’’. He ordered Sikhs that each Sikh should have the surname of ‘’Singh” and have hold Kesh, Kangha, Kachha, Kripan and Kada. 14. How many years ago Khalsa Panth started ? (a) 150 (b) 300 (c) 200 (d) 400 M.P. P.C.S. (Pre) 2000 Ans. (b) Khalsa Panth was established on 13th April, 1699, on the day of Baisakhi by 10th Sikh Guru Gobind Singh in Anandpur Sahib. Therefore, it has been almost 300 years when Khalsa Panth started. 15. Which among the following Sikh Gurus instituted the Khalsa Panth? (b) The real name of Banda Bahadur was Lachhman Dev. This name was given to him by Sikh Guru Gobind Singh. 20. The last king of the Sikh Kingdom was- (a) Daleep Singh (b) Naunihal Singh (c) Ranjit Singh (d) Sher Singh U.P.P.C.S. (Mains) 2010 Ans. (a) The last king of Sikh kingdom was Dilip Singh. In second Anglo-Sikh war (1849), English annexed Punjab and provided a pension to Daleep (Duleep) Singh and was sent to Britain.
